description: Labelled pairs for federated deduplication (v1-e08-t02-normalize-dedupe, ac4). Each pair is two CandidateResults as the discovery adapters map them, and `expected` says whether they are the same source (one MergedCandidate) or different sources (two). Every record and every expected answer was written by hand, before the matching code, from what each provider is documented to return; none was produced by running the deduplication. The records are synthetic: titles, authors, DOIs and URLs are invented in the shape of real ones. Every pair is a different work, so the whole file can also be deduplicated at once without one pair's records belonging with another's. `tags` names the case a pair stands for; the hard negatives the PM asked for are tagged near-identical-headlines-different-authors, same-title-different-years, preprint-and-published and syndicated-news.
